# Operability, Security and API Conventions Checklist: Project Foundation (RM-1)

**Purpose**: PR reviewer gate before `/speckit-implement`, testing the quality of the RM-1 requirements for (A) operability and security (FR-015 to FR-019) and (B) API conventions and schema changes (FR-002, FR-003, FR-011 to FR-013), and their consistency with plan.md, design.md (Frozen), contracts/, research.md, data-model.md and constitution v1.4.0.
**Created**: 2026-09-30
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

**Scope**: Out of scope (deferred to RM-2/RM-3): log rotation and capture, the external uptime check, the production configuration file, sign-in, `/my-issues`, and the NFR-002/NFR-003 timing numbers. Shared UI states are not a mandatory focus.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Does the spec state which settings are "required" for FR-018, or is the required set defined only in data-model.md (`DATABASE_URL`, `TEST_DATABASE_URL`)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018, Gap]
- [x] CHK002 Is it specified which processes FR-018's refusal applies to (dev server, `npm start`, `db:migrate`, `npm test`), given the spec says only "the app" while contracts/commands.md gives the refusal for `npm start` and data-model.md makes `TEST_DATABASE_URL` required only for `npm test`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018, Spec §User Story 1 scenario 3]
- [x] CHK003 Are requirements defined for a setting that is present but malformed (for example an unparseable `DATABASE_URL`), as distinct from missing or empty? [Gap, Spec §FR-018]
- [x] CHK004 Does the spec define the `/health` response bodies and caching rules, or are `{"status":"ok"}`, `{"status":"unavailable"}` and "never cached" defined only in contracts/http-api.md? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019]
- [x] CHK005 Is the `/health` database time limit (800 ms in research R10) traceable to a spec requirement, so that a hanging database is covered by FR-019 and not only by SC-004? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK006 Are the `401` and `422` top-level `message` texts specified, given contracts/http-api.md shows them as "…"? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK007 Are requirements defined for `/api/…` failures outside the listed codes: a known path with an unsupported method, a malformed or non-JSON request body, and a wrong `Content-Type`? [Gap, Spec §FR-011, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK008 Does FR-013 specify the request ID's format, what happens when it is missing or malformed on a create, and what a repeat with the same ID but a different body returns, or are these left to contracts/http-api.md and later slices? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK009 Is the recovery path after a failed schema change specified: that fixing the failing file and rerunning the command resumes from that file and leaves earlier ones untouched? [Gap, Recovery, Spec §FR-002, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK010 Are requirements defined for two schema-change runs at the same time against one database (locking or refusal)? [Gap, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK011 Does the spec state that each schema change is applied atomically, and what happens to a change whose statements cannot run inside a transaction? [Gap, Spec §FR-002, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK012 Is the edge case "a request's duration can't be measured because it errors inside the server: it is still logged with status `500` and its duration" worded unambiguously, given it says the duration both can't be measured and is logged? [Ambiguity, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK013 Are the start and end points of "duration in milliseconds" and its rounding defined in the spec, or only in data-model.md ("whole milliseconds from handler start to response")? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK014 Is "API request" defined for FR-015 so it is unambiguous whether `GET /health` (not under `/api/`) and the `/api/…` 404 catch-all each produce a log line, as contracts/http-api.md says `/health` is "logged like any API request"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015, Spec §FR-019]
- [x] CHK015 Is "without revealing internal details" (FR-019) and "no internal detail" (FR-012) defined with a concrete rule (for example: no stack, no error message, no database or host names)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012, Spec §FR-019]
- [x] CHK016 Is "one message per field" for `422` clear about field naming for nested or repeated inputs and about a field with more than one problem? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK017 Does SC-006 say whether "a search of the repository" covers only the working tree or also git history? [Clarity, Spec §SC-006, Spec §FR-017]
- [x] CHK018 Is "resource-style paths" defined in the spec (plural nouns, readable IDs), or only in contracts/http-api.md? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK019 Is the extra `level: "error"` line that data-model.md and research R9 add on an unexpected error consistent with FR-015's "one line per API request" and the Key Entities' log entry fields (time, method, path, status, duration)? [Conflict, Spec §FR-015, Spec §Key Entities]
- [x] CHK020 Do User Story 4 scenario 2 (method, path, status, duration) and the Key Entities log entry (adds time in UTC) list the same log fields? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 4, Spec §Key Entities]
- [x] CHK021 Are FR-018 (refuse to start on a missing setting), the Edge Case (start anyway when the database is unreachable) and FR-019 (`503` when the database is down) consistent about which start-up failures stop the app? [Consistency, Spec §FR-018, Spec §FR-019, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK022 Is FR-020's requirement that every shared piece in FR-007 to FR-019 be covered by an automated test consistent with FR-003 and FR-013, which this slice only documents (plan: "The request-ID convention is documented, not coded"), and with FR-017, whose check (SC-006) is a repository search? [Conflict, Spec §FR-020, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-013, Spec §FR-017]
- [x] CHK023 Is the `/health` `503` body (`{"status":"unavailable"}`) consistent with FR-011's single shared error shape, or is `/health` explicitly exempted from it in the spec? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, Spec §FR-019]
- [x] CHK024 Is the generic `500` message "Something went wrong." in contracts/http-api.md consistent with design.md, whose open question 2 rejected that wording for user-facing copy, and is it stated that no screen shows it? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012]

## Security and Log Content Coverage

- [x] CHK025 Does FR-016 cover output other than the per-request log, such as the start-up refusal message, the schema-change command's failure report and database driver error text, which can carry connection strings or data values? [Coverage, Spec §FR-016, Spec §FR-018, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK026 Is the content allowed in an unexpected-error log entry (research R9: error name only, no message or stack) stated as a requirement in the spec? [Gap, Spec §FR-016]
- [x] CHK027 Beyond "tokens never go in path segments", are requirements defined for other sensitive values that could appear in a logged path (for example email addresses or member text), given the path is always logged? [Gap, Spec §FR-016]
- [x] CHK028 Is the rule that `TEST_DATABASE_URL` must differ from `DATABASE_URL`, and that the test command refuses otherwise (research R5), traceable to a spec requirement? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-017]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK029 Is there an objectively checkable acceptance criterion for FR-003 (schema changes work with the previous release's code) in RM-1, beyond AGENTS.md recording the rule? [Measurability, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK030 Can FR-016's "never contain … description and comment text" be verified in RM-1, which has no such text, and does SC-005 name how the searched values are chosen? [Measurability, Spec §FR-016, Spec §SC-005]
- [x] CHK031 Do User Story 5's independent test and acceptance scenarios cover the `500` guard (FR-012) and the request ID convention (FR-013), or only `404` and `422`? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 5, Spec §FR-012, Spec §FR-013]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [x] CHK032 Is FR-001's claim that the section 12 stack and the DEC-005 test tools are approved consistent with constitution v1.3.0 Principle IV, whose approved list names only Hairline, Lucide and `lucide-react` and says "Nothing else is approved", while plan.md records `next`, `react`, `postgres`, `vitest` and others as owner-approved under Q1 and Q2? [Conflict, Spec §FR-001, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK033 Is the assumption that one configuration-file mechanism serves both development and production (Spec §Assumptions) consistent with FR-017's wording and with research R3's choice of `.env.local`, so RM-2 does not need a different file? [Assumption, Spec §FR-017]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
